name: 7+ Taskbar Tweaker

notes: Freeware with no nags or paywalls; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: 7-Zip
description: 7-Zip is a file archiver with high compression ratios that supports many archive formats. It is released under the LGPL.

name: A Note
description: Lightweight desktop sticky notes app with colored notes, fonts, alarms and docking to screen edges. Open source (GPL) with no ads or paid tiers.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the standalone project's own site could not be verified; official_url is the PortableApps entry (third party). PortableApps lists App License: Open Source (GPL) and release 4.2.4 (2013-01-05). URL note: original developer site is gone; PortableApps.com (co-publisher, GPL source linked) is the maintained distribution and serves as the primary download.

name: AkelPad
description: A plain-text editor for Windows with syntax highlighting, tabbed editing and plugin support.
notes: License verified earlier as BSD open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: Angry IP Scanner
description: Fast cross-platform IP address and port scanner, released under the GPLv2. Some antivirus products flag it because it performs network scans.

name: AniFX
description: Cursor editor for creating and editing static and animated cursors. Imports images, extracts cursors from EXE and DLL files and batch-processes files.
notes: PortableApps release notes: freeware for personal and business use. Wikipedia notes development was discontinued after features were folded into IcoFX 2.0, but v1.0 remains functional. Could not verify an official developer site; Attila Kovrig's original site appears offline, so a download mirror is listed as the URL. Kept Utilities/Look: cursor creation is a desktop-look tool.

name: Ant Renamer
description: A batch file and folder renamer with rules for string replacement, case changes, regular expressions and metadata-based renaming.
notes: Open source: SourceForge lists GPL-2.0, AlternativeTo cites GPL-3.0. Active (v2.13.0 released December 2024).

name: Apache OpenOffice
description: Full open-source office suite (Apache License 2.0) with Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base and Math. Actively released (4.1.16, Nov 2025) and free for any purpose including commercial use.
notes: Project strongly warns users to download only from the official site. Also listed in the Microsoft Store for selected languages; could not verify a stable store URL so no alt added.

name: AquaSnap
description: A window management tool that adds snapping, tiling, window docking and desktop splitting to Windows.
free_enough_reason: The free Personal version is a complete product; multi-monitor support is the only significant feature reserved for the paid tier.
notes: Free for personal use. Could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: Artha
description: An offline English thesaurus based on WordNet with global hotkey lookup and regular-expression search.
notes: GPL-2 open source. Development appears stalled (latest release 1.0.3), but the Windows build works offline and passes the bar.

name: Attribute Changer
description: A tool for changing file and folder attributes, timestamps and photo dates in bulk.
notes: Freeware for personal and business use; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: AutoHotkey
description: Scripting language for Windows automation (GPLv2). Creates hotkeys, text expansions, macros and small utilities.

name: Autoruns
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that shows every program configured to start automatically with Windows and lets you disable entries. It covers the registry, startup folders, services, drivers and scheduled tasks.

name: BabelMap
description: A Unicode character map for browsing over 110,000 characters and copying them to the clipboard.
notes: Freeware by BabelStone: free to download and use for personal or commercial purposes, fully featured, no ads, no IAP. The developer asks users to download only from babelstone.co.uk.

name: BabelPad
description: Unicode text editor and word processor by Andrew West with full Unicode character support. Free for personal and commercial use, fully featured, single executable with no installer, no ads or in-app purchases.
notes: Author asks users to download only from babelstone.co.uk and does not support third-party distributions. Verified free for commercial use on the official page.

name: Balabolka
description: Freeware text-to-speech program that reads documents aloud using installed Windows voices and can save speech to audio files. It supports many file formats, custom dictionaries and pronunciation rules.
notes: Donations are accepted; the separate paid product Cross+A is unrelated to the free Balabolka.

name: Bitwarden Desktop
description: Password manager with end-to-end encrypted sync across devices. Core features are free; a Bitwarden account is required.
free_enough_reason: paid Premium adds extras such as file storage and TOTP, but the free tier covers unlimited items and sync.

name: Blank And Secure
description: Portable file shredder from SoftwareOK. Overwrites files with random data and can wipe free disk space. Donations are accepted but no nagging is reported.

name: BleachBit
description: Open source privacy cleaner (GPL-3.0) that deletes caches, temp files, cookies and history from browsers and the system. It has no ads, accounts or paid tier.

name: Blender
description: Blender is a 3D creation suite for modeling, animation, rendering and video editing. It is developed by the Blender Foundation and released under the GPL.

name: BOINC
description: Open-source middleware for volunteer computing (LGPL). Donate idle CPU time to research projects such as disease and climate science.
notes: UNCERTAIN: no taxonomy basket fits distributed computing; kept input placement System/Automate.

name: BYOND
description: Platform for making and playing online multiplayer 2D games. Includes the Dream Maker scripting language, a game hub and hosting tools.
notes: PortableApps release notes: freeware for personal and business use. Proprietary, not open source. No trial or upsell inside the client. Games/Players basket kept: it is primarily a game client and community.

name: Capture2Text
description: A tool that runs OCR on a selected screen region and copies the recognized text to the clipboard.
notes: GPL open source (SourceForge).

name: cdrtfe
description: Front end for cdrtools that burns data, audio and video CDs, DVDs and Blu-rays. Creates ISO images and extracts audio tracks.
notes: GPL v2 confirmed on SourceForge; current version 1.5.9.1 (Sept 2024). Basket System/Disks kept.

name: Checksum Control
description: A wizard-style utility for generating and verifying file checksums in SFV and MD5 formats.
notes: GPL open source per PortableFreeware; could not verify the developer's own download URL in this pass.

name: Cherrytree
description: Hierarchical note-taking app (GPLv3) storing rich text, images, tables, links and code snippets in a single file, with password protection. Actively maintained by Giuseppe Penone.
notes: UNCERTAIN: official site URL — sources cite both giuspen.net/cherrytree and giuspen.com/cherrytree; used the most recent citation (giuspen.net). GitHub repo giuspen/cherrytree confirms open source.

name: Chromium
description: Open-source browser project maintained by Google. It is the upstream code base behind Chrome, Edge, Opera and other Chromium-based browsers.

name: ClamWin
description: Windows front end for the ClamAV antivirus engine, released under the GPL.

name: Clicky Gone
description: A tool that automatically hides the mouse cursor when it has not moved for a while.
notes: License verified earlier as GPL-2.0 open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: Colour Contrast Analyser

notes: GPLv3 open source by TPGi.

notes: Freeware by Xyntec for personal and business use; last release 2012 but the local tool still works. Could not verify the developer's own download URL in this pass.

name: ConvertAll
description: A unit converter that lets units be combined freely, for example converting inches per decade to other units.
notes: GPL-2.0 open source.

name: Cook Timer

notes: Open source and completely free per PortableApps; could not verify the developer's own download URL in this pass.

name: CopyQ
description: A clipboard manager with tabs, scripting and a command-line interface that stores text, image and HTML clips.
notes: GPL-3.0 open source.

name: Coreinfo

name: Cppcheck

notes: GPL-3.0 open source.

name: CPU-Z

name: CpuFrequenz
description: Freeware tool by SoftwareOK that shows CPU load and clock frequency in real time with a load graph and a precise frequency determination mode. Actively maintained (v4.55, Apr 2026).

name: Cryptomator
description: Client-side encryption for cloud folders. Creates encrypted vaults that sync through any cloud provider; open source under the GPLv3.

name: CrystalDiskInfo
description: Open source disk health monitor that reads S.M.A.R.T. data and shows drive temperature, error counts and overall health status. It is MIT licensed with no paid tier.

name: CrystalDiskMark

name: CrystalMark Retro

name: Daphne
description: Open source process manager (GPL, source published on the author's site) that can kill, debug and control windows, with drag-over-window targeting, always-on-top rules and process traps. Latest release v2.04 (2014); the official site now lists it under legacy.
notes: Project is archived/legacy but functional. Per the author, the installers offer no third-party software and the app is free of charge.

name: Database Browser
description: A visual database tool for creating, browsing and querying databases with a spreadsheet-style interface.
notes: Freeware by Db Software Laboratory (etl-tools.com); last release around 2020. Could not verify official download URL in this pass.

description: Professional video editing suite with editing, color grading, Fusion VFX and Fairlight audio. Free edition edits and exports up to 4K UHD at 60fps.

notes: Paid tier exists and the free tier is a complete product for most editors, so free_enough=true. Limits that matter are disclosed: 4K UHD/60fps cap, single-GPU use, Studio-only AI tools and noise reduction. Third-party comparisons state no account registration is needed for the free edition; could not verify this on blackmagicdesign.com. Official URL not verified verbatim; blackmagicdesign.com used.

name: DB Browser for SQLite
description: A visual tool for creating, designing and editing SQLite database files through a spreadsheet-like interface, with no SQL knowledge required.
notes: GPL-3.0+/MPL-2.0 open source.

name: DebugView
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that captures debug output (OutputDebugString and DbgPrint) from drivers and programs in real time. Latest release v4.90 (2019); functional and unmaintained.

name: DesktopSnowOK
description: Tiny portable tool that adds falling snowflakes (or leaves, flowers or stars) to the desktop. Configurable flake styles, count, speed and transparency.
notes: Freeware confirmed on softwareok.com, which states it is free for private, commercial and government use without restrictions. Current v7.11. Basket Utilities/Gadgets kept: it is a desktop novelty.

name: Detect It Easy
description: A tool that identifies file types and detects the compiler, linker or packer used to build a binary.
notes: MIT open source.

name: Dia

Basket corrected from Productivity/Office to Productivity/Design: a Design basket exists and fits diagramming better.

name: Dicom

name: DiffImg

notes: License verified earlier as GPL-2.0 open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

notes: License verified earlier as GPL-2 open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

notes: License verified earlier as GPL-2.0 open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

notes: GPL open source per PortableFreeware forums; PortableApps describes it as open source and completely free. Could not verify the developer's own download URL in this pass.

name: Don't Sleep

name: EarTrumpet

name: Emsisoft Emergency Kit
description: Portable on-demand malware scanner and remover. Free for personal use; no installation needed.

name: Eraser Classic

name: Eraser .Net

name: FeedRoller

notes: Discontinued by the developer, but PortableApps still distributes v1.20 and describes it as freeware for business and personal use. Could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: uGet
description: Download manager for Windows, Linux and Android. The Windows build is ad-free; the Android version shows ads, which does not affect the Windows build.

name: UNetbootin
description: Open source tool that creates bootable USB drives for Linux distributions. It is GPL-2.0-or-later licensed; the latest stable release (702) dates from Feb 2021 but it remains functional.

name: Unicodia
description: A tool for browsing Unicode character data and code charts.
notes: License verified earlier as GPL-3.0 open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: UUID-GUID Generator
description: A tool that generates UUID/GUID values and copies them to the clipboard.
notes: License verified earlier as GPL open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: Ventoy
description: Open source tool that turns a USB drive into a multiboot device by simply copying ISO files onto it, with no reformatting. It is GPL-3.0-or-later licensed.
notes: Wikipedia notes parts of the project ecosystem are only partially open source; the core tool is GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: VeraCrypt
description: Disk and partition encryption tool forked from TrueCrypt, under the VeraCrypt license.

name: Virtual Magnifying Glass
description: Open source screen magnifier that shows a zoomed view of the area under the mouse cursor in a floating window. It works on any application without installation.
notes: GPL-2.0 licensed project on SourceForge.

name: Virtual Volumes View
description: Virtual Volumes View catalogs offline media and archives so they can be searched later. It is released under the GPL; version 1.5 released Jan 2024.

name: VirtuaWin
description: A virtual desktop manager for Windows with configurable hotkeys, mouse edge switching and a plugin system.
notes: GPL-2.0 open source; updated as recently as 2025 (v4.5).

name: VMMap
description: Freeware Sysinternals tool that breaks down a process's virtual and physical memory by type, such as heap, stack, image and mapped files. Useful for finding memory leaks.

name: VS Code
description: Microsoft's code editor with debugging, syntax highlighting and a large extension marketplace.
notes: The Microsoft binary is proprietary freeware (Wikipedia: 'Proprietary freeware based on open-source project'); the underlying Code-OSS source is MIT-licensed. Sign-in is optional (settings sync only).

name: VSCodium
description: Community-built binaries of VS Code made from the MIT-licensed open-source codebase, without Microsoft branding or telemetry.
notes: MIT open source. winget install -e --id VSCodium.VSCodium documented on AlternativeTo.

name: WackGet
description: Download manager and accelerator. The original MillWeed site is offline; builds are distributed via PortableApps.com.
notes: original site offline; could not verify an official download page.

name: WhatChanged
description: Freeware tool by Vista Software that scans the registry and file system for changes between two snapshots. Latest release is from 2010; unmaintained but functional, free for personal and business use.
notes: Developer site no longer offers the download; PortableApps is the working source.

name: WhoDat
description: Simple WHOIS lookup utility for domain and IP registration records.
notes: last release 0.9 (2013); could not verify an active developer site; distributed via PortableApps.com; UNCERTAIN whether it works on Windows 11.

name: WhyNotWin11
description: Open source (LGPL-3.0) detection tool that checks which Windows 11 requirements a PC fails, such as TPM, Secure Boot, CPU generation and storage. It runs as a single executable with no ads.

name: Winaero Tweaker
description: A tweaking tool for adjusting hidden Windows settings and behaviour without editing the registry by hand.
notes: Freeware with no nags or paywalls; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: WinCDEmu
description: Open source virtual disc tool that mounts ISO, CUE, NRG and other image files as virtual CD and DVD drives. It is LGPL-3.0 licensed; unmaintained since 2015 but functional.

name: WinCompose
description: A compose key for Windows that types special characters and emoji with short intuitive key sequences.
notes: WTFPL open source (MIT also cited by OpenHub). Actively forked and maintained (ell1010/thpoll83 forks ship current releases).

name: WinContig
description: Freeware defragmenter by Marco D'Amato that defragments individual files or folders instead of whole disks. It is free for personal and business use with no ads or upsells.

name: WinDirStat
description: WinDirStat is a disk usage statistics viewer with a treemap display. It is released under the GPLv2; version 2.8.0 released Aug 2026.

name: Windows Error Lookup Tool
description: Open source (GPL-3.0) error code lookup tool that translates Windows, NTSTATUS, DirectX and STOP codes into readable descriptions. It is portable and actively maintained.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the row name matches 'Windows Error Lookup Tool' by Gunners Software (freeware, unmaintained since v3.0.7 in 2013); this verdict covers the distinct, actively maintained 'Error Lookup' by Henry++, which fits the row's description.

name: WinFile
description: WinFile is the classic Windows File Manager, open-sourced by Microsoft. It is released under the MIT license.

name: winMd5Sum
description: A tool that computes MD5 checksums of files to verify download integrity.
notes: License verified earlier as GPL-3.0 open source per SourceForge; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: WinMerge
description: A visual file and folder comparison tool with merging support for text files.
notes: License verified earlier as GPL-2.0 open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass.

name: WinMTR
description: Visual Windows port of MTR combining ping and traceroute in one tool, released under the GPLv2. Barely maintained but still functional.

name: WinObj
description: Freeware Sysinternals viewer for the NT Object Manager namespace, showing devices, drivers, symbolic links and other kernel objects. It is the definitive tool for exploring the object directory.

name: WinPenguins
description: Desktop toy that sends cute penguins wandering across windows, the taskbar and the screen edge. Pop them with the cursor or steer the skateboarders with arrow keys.
notes: GPL confirmed on the ricky65/WinPenguins GitHub repo and SoftLookup. Active: v1.2 supports Windows 10/11 and is on the Microsoft Store. Basket Utilities/Gadgets kept.

name: WinSCP
description: SFTP, FTP, SCP and WebDAV client for Windows, released under the GPL.

name: WinWGet
description: Windows GUI front end for the GNU Wget downloader, released under the GPLv2.
notes: could not verify the developer's download page; the WinWGet+ fork is closed-source freeware and is a different project.

name: WireGuard
description: Official Windows client for the WireGuard VPN protocol. The client is free and open source; you supply the VPN server configuration.

name: Wise Disk Cleaner
description: Freeware junk-file cleaner by WiseCleaner that removes temporary files, browser traces and other clutter to free disk space. The official site states the free edition is completely free with lifetime updates.

name: Wise Duplicate Finder
description: Wise Duplicate Finder finds and removes duplicate files on a drive. It is freeware.
free_enough_reason: The free version fully searches for and deletes duplicate files; only the automatic 'Keep One' option requires the Pro version.

name: Wise Force Deleter
description: Wise Force Deleter deletes files locked by other processes. It is completely free with no paid tier.

name: Wise JetSearch
description: Wise JetSearch is a file search tool from WiseCleaner. It is freeware.

name: Wise Program Uninstaller
description: Freeware uninstaller by WiseCleaner that removes desktop programs, Windows apps and browser extensions, with force uninstall for broken entries.
free_enough_reason: The free edition is a complete uninstaller with leftover cleanup, force uninstall and no ads, per TechRadar and Gizmodo reviews.
notes: UNCERTAIN: third-party pages (an IObit comparison, coupon listings) reference a newer paid Pro tier (~$9.97/yr) adding deeper leftover scanning and support; could not verify its feature split on the official site.

name: Wise Registry Cleaner
description: Freeware registry cleaner by WiseCleaner that scans for invalid entries, backs up changes before cleaning and defragments the registry.
free_enough_reason: The free edition is a complete registry cleaner; Pro adds multi-user scanning and priority support.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the product page URL could not be captured verbatim, so the official homepage is used above. Could not verify whether the free edition shows Pro upgrade prompts.

name: WizFile
description: WizFile is a disk search utility from Antibody Software. It is freeware; personal use is free while commercial use requires a Supporter or Enterprise license.

name: WizTree
description: WizTree is a disk space analyzer that scans drives quickly. It is freeware, free for personal use only; commercial use requires a paid license.

name: XAMPP
description: One-installer package of Apache, MariaDB/MySQL, PHP and Perl for local web development. Includes phpMyAdmin and a control panel to start and stop services.
notes: Apache Friends releases the XAMPP compilation under the GPL; bundled components carry their own licenses. Completely free, no paid tiers and no upsell in the product. Basket confirmed.

name: XN Resource Editor
description: A resource editor and PE module explorer with special support for Delphi programs.
notes: MPL/GPL open source. The original developer site is gone; stefansundin.github.io hosts a mirror of the last build (3.0.0.1) and source is mirrored on GitHub.

name: Yubico Authenticator
description: Desktop app that generates one-time passcodes from a YubiKey hardware key. Open source; requires a YubiKey.
notes: requires a YubiKey hardware key; could not verify the exact OSI license from search results.

name: YUMI exFAT
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL) for exFAT-formatted drives that boots multiple operating systems from one USB stick. Latest release v1.0.2.4 (Oct 2023).

name: YUMI Legacy
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL-2.0) that installs multiple Linux distributions and tools on one drive. Archived at v2.0.9.4 (Jan 2022); the publisher recommends the exFAT variant for current use.

name: YUMI UEFI
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL-2.0) with UEFI support. It remains an archived preview at v0.0.4.5 (Mar 2022).

name: Zettlr
description: Open-source (GPL-3.0) Markdown editor for researchers and note-takers with citation support, Zettelkasten knowledge management and exports via Pandoc and LaTeX.
notes: Donations requested on the site; all features work without donating.

name: Zim
description: Desktop personal wiki (GPL-2.0-or-later) keeping notes as plain-text wiki pages in a folder structure, with linking, plugins, task list and equation editor. Actively released (0.77.0, June 2026).
notes: URL scheme (https) assumed for zim-wiki.org; could not verify canonical scheme. Windows builds support 64-bit Windows 10 only.

name: Zint Barcode Studio
description: A GUI for generating barcodes and QR codes in over 50 symbologies and exporting them as image files.
notes: Dual-licensed: the encoding library is BSD-3-clause and the GUI/CLI are GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Zoom
description: Video conferencing app for meetings, webinars and chat. Free Basic plan supports up to 100 participants.
free_enough_reason: Basic is a permanent free plan with unlimited meetings for up to 100 participants; the 40-minute per-meeting cap is a standing product limit, not a trial.
notes: Free tier clears the bar: Zoom Workplace Basic is permanent, not a trial, with unlimited meetings. The 40-minute limit on every meeting (including 1-on-1s since 2022) is a product limitation, and the meeting can be restarted for free. Judgment: free_enough=true, with the cap disclosed so users know the boundary. Requires a free Zoom account to host; could not verify whether guests can join without an account. Official URL not verified verbatim; zoom.us used.

name: ZoomIt
description: A Microsoft Sysinternals tool for zooming the screen and annotating during presentations. It is also bundled with PowerToys.
notes: Microsoft freeware with no nags, ads or paywalls. Could not verify official download URL in this pass.
